    NATURALLY NON-STICK

    Pure titanium is naturally non-stick, and its hammered surface creates thousands of micro-reliefs that reduce contact with food. No special technique, no tricks. You cook normally — nothing sticks. A drizzle of oil is all it takes for a perfect sear, cooking lighter and healthier.

    ZERO TOXIC COATING

    The Titanox isn't a "titanium" pan at 3%. It's 100% pure titanium — a 3-layer construction:

    ✔ Pure titanium surface — naturally non-stick, scratch-proof, toxin-free

    ✔ Aluminum core — fast, even heat, no hot spots

    ✔ Ferritic stainless steel base — maximum strength, induction compatible

    One pan. For life.

    ✔ Gas, electric, ceramic

    ✔ Metal utensils allowed — nothing scratches titanium

    ✔ Dishwasher safe — or just a quick wipe

    7 REASONS

    Why TITANOX will be
    the last pan you ever buy

    The pure titanium pan that replaces all the others.

    1A SURFACE THAT DOESN’T STICK

    Pure titanium is naturally non-stick, and its hammered surface creates thousands of micro-reliefs that reduce contact with food. This combination helps prevent sticking without any coating.

    2COOK WITHOUT TOXINS, ZERO PFAS, PTFE OR PFOA

    No chemical coating ends up in your food. You cook directly on a pure titanium surface, a safer material that does not release harmful compounds into your meals.

    3TITANIUM FOR DEEPER FLAVOR

    Titanium conducts heat up to three times better than stainless steel. Heat spreads evenly across the surface, helping preserve aromas and giving your meals a richer, more flavorful cook.

    43X LESS OIL

    No need to drown your food in oil to get great results. A small drizzle is enough to cook the way you like it, while keeping meals lighter and cleaner.

    5COMPATIBLE WITH EVERY STOVETOP

    Induction, gas, electric, glass-ceramic, and oven. Titanox works perfectly on all cooking surfaces and fits effortlessly into your kitchen.

    6EASY TO CLEAN

    Warm water, a little soap, a quick wipe, and it looks like new. It is also fully dishwasher-safe.

    7BUILT FROM METAL, BACKED FOR LIFE

    This is not a disposable pan with a “titanium-effect” coating. It is a pan built from metal, made to be durable, and designed to stay in your kitchen for years.

    Frequently Asked Questions – Titanox®

    Does the Titanox stick?

    No. That's the whole difference with 100% pure titanium. No special technique, no tricks. You cook normally — nothing sticks. The hammered surface is naturally non-stick, without any chemical coating.

    Why titanium instead of a regular non-stick pan?

    Because your non-stick pan is poisoning you. PTFE and PFOA coatings break down with heat and release toxic microparticles directly into your food. You eat them. Every day. Pure titanium contains no coating, no chemicals, no risk. It's the safest metal in the world — even used in medical implants.

    Is it compatible with my stove?

    Yes — every stovetop, no exceptions. Induction, gas, electric, ceramic, and even oven up to 500°F. The ferritic stainless steel base ensures full compatibility. And metal utensils are allowed — titanium doesn't scratch.

    Is it really guaranteed for life?

    Yes. For life. No conditions. Pure titanium doesn't wear out, doesn't flake, doesn't degrade. It will be in your kitchen 10 years from now, 20 years from now — exactly like day one. If a defect ever appears, we replace it. Simple.

    Is it easy to clean?

    A quick wipe with a sponge is enough. Often just hot water. Nothing sticks, nothing burns — cleaning takes 10 seconds. It's also dishwasher safe.

    Does it really contain zero PFAS?

    Zero PFAS. Zero PTFE. Zero PFOA. No coating, no treatment, no hidden chemicals. The Titanox is made from 100% pure titanium — certified toxin-free and biocompatible. What you cook in it is food. Nothing else.

    Which size should I choose?

    10 inch — ideal for 1 to 2 people. Eggs, vegetables, fish.

    11 inch — the versatile size for 2 to 4 people. Our best seller.

    12 inch — perfect for families and larger meals. Steaks, stir-fries, one-pan dinners.

    Does the handle get hot?

    No. The Titanox handle is designed to stay cool — even after long cooking sessions. You can grab it bare-handed in complete safety.

    Can I use metal utensils?

    Yes. Pure titanium doesn't scratch. Spatulas, whisks, metal tongs — no problem. Where a regular non-stick pan gets damaged on first contact, the Titanox stays flawless.

    Is the pan oven-safe?

    Yes. The Titanox withstands temperatures up to 500°F without warping, without releasing toxic fumes. Sear on the stove, finish in the oven — it handles both without compromise.

    What are the delivery times?

    Delivery times vary depending on the season and stock, but your order is processed quickly after confirmation. 3 to 5 business days for the United States.

    How do I track my order?

    As soon as your order ships, you'll receive an email with your tracking number. You can also track it via the dedicated tracking page on our website.
